query: SELECT r.id FROM core.parser_runs r JOIN raw.source_documents d ON d.id=r.source_document_id WHERE r.source_document_id=$1 AND r.parser_name='connector-structured-json' AND r.parser_version='connector-structured-json-v1' AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' AND r.input_content_sha256=d.content_sha256 AND r.extraction_schema_version='v1' AND r.output_record_count=$2 AND r.output_digest=$3 AND r.extraction_receipt_sha256=$4 ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id LIMIT 1
